text: Derive the expression P = ⅓ρc² from the kinetic theory of gases.

points.text: A molecule of speed c_x hitting a wall changes its momentum by 2mc_x.

Adding all molecules gives a pressure of Nmc̄²/(3V).
With ρ = Nm/V, P = ⅓ρc².
